notes: «قَالَ أَبِي رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَيَّ»: a cited letter by the author, a bare relation ("أبي"). The author of a cited book or letter is sent to a ruling (rule 11). The text gives no transmitter beyond him.

«قَالَ أَبِي رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَيَّ»: a cited letter by the author, a bare relation ("أبي"). The author of a cited book or letter is sent to a ruling (rule 11). The text gives no transmitter beyond him.
«قَالَ أَبِي ... فِي رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَيَّ» is the author of a cited letter (rule 11): the father's rule is written, but who the father is is not decided here
the father is named only as a bare relation; no other link is written
